applies_why: The judge text addresses whether C4/Jeremiah 22:30 counts against the curse limb but declines to count it because no live link remains.
quote: C4 pressed against the curse limb the defender dropped in [CR3] LINK 5, so no live link remains to contradict; the dropping is recorded there.
rule_words: A verse on a side's 'cited in' line counts as an unanswered witness only when the judge quotes the sentence of the earlier round that pressed it against that link or a listed premise and names that round; a verse cited there but not pressed against the link does not count. Not counting it obeys this rule.
room: counts as an unanswered witness: I weighed whether the rule governs any mention of a pressed verse or only a verse actually counted against a live link; I read it as the latter.
why: Because the judge does not count Jeremiah 22:30 toward a broken live link, but instead treats the pressed limb as dropped, not counting it obeys K-G4.
